description: This file contains utility functions for text generation, including random string, name, and post generation, as well as constants and variables for fuzz testing and markdown content.

methods.name: RandString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length using the provided charset.

methods.name: SecureRandString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random string of specified length.

methods.name: RandomName
methods.description: Generates a random name string of specified length and charset.

methods.name: FuzzName
methods.description: Returns a random fuzzed name from predefined list.

methods.name: RandomText
methods.description: Generates a random text snippet with optional hashtags and mentions.

methods.name: FuzzPost
methods.description: Returns a random fuzzed post string from predefined list.
